texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Baggao: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.

4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.

texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Diadi: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.

texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Diadi
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.

💧 Uminom ng maraming tubig
🐔 Bantayan ang mga hayop

#HeatStress #DARFOCagayanValley

texts.bulletin: DANGEROUS HEAT STRESS — Saguday: WBGT index in danger zone. SUSPEND all field work from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Ensure field workers rest in shade and drink water every 15 minutes. Monitor livestock — ensure shade, ventilation, and clean water for poultry/swine. Coordinate with RHU/BHS on heat-related illness protocols. Apply irrigation to vegetable crops early morning or late afternoon only.
texts.sms: DA HEAT ALERT: Dangerous heat in Saguday. NO farm work 9AM-4PM. Drink water. Protect livestock.
texts.lgu:
HEAT STRESS EMERGENCY — Saguday
WBGT index in dangerous range.
1. Issue public health advisory with RHU.
2. Restrict field labor 9AM–4PM.
3. Coordinate BAI for livestock heat stress monitoring.
4. Ensure water availability at farm sites.
texts.facebook:
🌡️ HEAT DANGER ALERT — Saguday

Mapanganib na init ngayon!
⛔ Huwag magtrabaho sa bukid mula 9AM–4PM
💧 Uminom ng maraming tubig
🐔 Bantayan ang mga hayop

#HeatStress #DARFOCagayanValley
